summary: Outdoors, a nonmagical oak tree springs up.
text: A single-use, feather-shaped token that only works outdoors. As a Magic action, touch it to an empty spot on the ground: the token vanishes and an ordinary, nonmagical oak springs up in its place, 60 feet tall with a trunk 5 feet across and a crown spreading 20 feet in every direction at the top.
